{{Top}}
'''Firefoam''', also known as '''suppression foam''' was a type of material that was used to douse [[Fire/Legends|fires]] aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. A number of canisters of high-expansion firefoam were kept aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], as part of a built-in network of fire-fighting equipment aboard the ship.
